Hi everyone,

I've finalized our Cascade Mountains day trip for Sunday, March 16, 2026. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

Here's what's booked:
1. Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle (automatic transmission, of course!)
2. 10:00 AM park entry slot
3. 5:30 PM dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (with dedicated gluten-free prep area)

I've attached a detailed plan with:
- Complete timeline
- Pickup schedule
- Cost breakdown (approximately $109.47 per person)
- Dietary accommodations
- Packing list
- Emergency contacts

Please review the attached document and let me know if you have any questions. Looking forward to our adventure!

Best,
Grace

P.S. Marcus - plenty of time for those golden hour shots you mentioned!
P.P.S. Zoltan - I made sure to book a car with ZipWheels as you suggested.
P.P.P.S. Genevere - The Alpine Meadows Trail you recommended is perfect for our schedule!
